ringmaster.label: The Ringmaster
ringmaster.instructions: Loud and quick like he's selling tickets to the whole street, always a laugh waiting under the words, and he leans on the big words like a drumroll.

gilt_whisper.label: Gilt Whisper
gilt_whisper.instructions: Low and close like he's letting you in on a secret, never raises his voice, every compliment sounds like a price tag.

road_drawl.label: Road Drawl
road_drawl.instructions: Easy and dry, like nothing on the road has ever really surprised him, short answers, a grin you can hear.

farm_girl.label: Farm Girl
farm_girl.instructions: Plain and steady with a bit of country in it, says exactly what she thinks and laughs at her own jokes.
